(NYSE: PINS) announced today that Bill Ready, CEO, will participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference. The session is scheduled for September 9, 2026 at 8:10 a.m PT / 11:10 a.m. ET. A live webcast and replay of the presentation will be publicly available on Pinterest’s Investor Relations website at investor.pinterest.com . Disclosure Information Pinterest uses and intends to continue to use its Investor Relations website as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Accordingly, investors should monitor the company’s Investor Relations website, in addition to following the company’s press releases, SEC filings, public conference calls, presentations and webcasts. About Pinterest Pinterest is a visual search and discovery platform where people find inspiration, curate ideas and shop products—all in a positive place online.
